title: Poetry package from a non-index source
description: poetry.lock declares a `source.type` other than the default index. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `source.type` other than the default index.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a `source.type` other than the default index.
limitation: It matches a `source.type` other than the default index in the parsed poetry.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
